# Selling Your Bangalore Flat? Why Clearing the Extras First Helps Buyers See the Space

** 24

## Thinking of selling your Bangalore flat? See how a Bangalore storage facility can help you remove the extras to enable buyers to visualize the real space.


Buyers evaluate space. If your rooms are cluttered with extra furniture, boxes, and stuff, even a spacious 2BHK feels small. While your flat is listed for sale,[StowNest](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+) can move your items to our safe storage facility, help buyers see the space, and transport your items to your new home.


## **The Weekend Visit that Went Quiet**


Let’s say you’ve listed your flat in Bangalore, and you’ve had a decent response with your agent scheduling a few visits for Saturday. You’ve spent the morning organizing the flat to make it presentable.


A couple strolls in and takes in the living room and both bedrooms. They have a quick look from the balcony. They are pleasant and tell you they will get back to you. You never hear from them.


> **Later your agent pulls you aside and tells you quietly, They liked the area, but the flat felt a bit tight.**


The flat is not tight. The second bedroom is not that small. But currently it houses a spare bed, a treadmill, a few cartons and a cupboard you were meaning to sell. What the couple saw was not a second bedroom. What they saw was a storage room.


## **Why Buyers Respond to Space More than You Think**


When buyers look at your home, they check rooms, then imagine their life there. Where would the couch go? Could the kids share that room? Would a desk fit by the window? The answer is usually no, the room is too small.


The presence of furniture, and especially clutter, can make a room appear much smaller than it is. Personal items, like family pictures, remind buyers that they are looking at your home, not their potential home.


The emptier version of your home, shows much better.


## **What "the Extras" Usually Means**


Clutter is not always easy to see. A quick walk-through often uncovers the same things.


Old sofas or spare beds. Boxes stored in a bedroom or on top of wardrobes. Old gym equipment, extra tables and chairs. A balcony stacked with cartons, folded cot and a bicycle. Shelves with books, show pieces and family photos.


Individually, each item is not very large, but together, they dominate a room.


## **Why You Can't Simply Throw it All Away**


You no doubt want the things that are in the way. This is the reason you have not already gotten rid of things you don't need.


You’ll need some furniture for the next place you live. Your dining table was a gift. The books and boxes are things you’ll go through later. Some things are sentimental. The cost to sell, move, and rebuy is often more than holding on to them.


You can’t ship everything to a relative, either. A relative’s spare room only goes so far, and you may still be living in the flat while it’s listed.


## **Storage Facilities Give Extras Somewhere to Go**


The practical side of you knows you need to list your flat, and you need to clear the rooms for potential buyers to see. You’re also aware your stuff needs to be safe and protected for the time being.


It’s the same as staging a flat, but with this service, you’re not losing anything.


## **How it Works With StowNest**


A storage service is usually simpler and less daunting than people expect, and you usually don’t need a truck.


You call customer service, let them know roughly what you want to store and for how long. A ballpark figure is often enough. They give you a price quote. Your items are picked up from your flat. You can also bring the items yourself to the[warehouse](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+) . You’d just have to contact customer service to make arrangements first.


Each item is tracked with a barcode, so we've got a record of what's being stored. You can see photos and videos of your stuff through the StowNest website. And when the sale is completed, you decide if you want your stuff delivered to the new address or back to you.


## **What to Clear, Room by Room**


You don't need to completely empty the house. A half-furnished home can work if it looks calm and open.


In the living room, keep the main sofa and one table. Else clear all additional chairs, a second diwan and large showpieces. In the bedrooms, keep the bed and one wardrobe. Else clear mattresses, desks and boxes. The second bedroom is usually the biggest win, so clear it fully or leave with just a bed or a simple desk. In the kitchen, pack away appliances and clear counter top items. On the balcony, clear everything including the cycles, folded furniture and cartons. A clear balcony is a selling point in **[Bangalore](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+)** . Clear the entrance of bags and shoe racks so the first view of the house is open.


## **A Realistic Timeline**


About 2-3 weeks before your listing photos. **[Call customer support](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+)** , share your list, and schedule a pickup. Once the extras are gone, you can touch up the walls, and do a deep clean of the rooms while you wait for the pics. The goal is to take pics before the open houses so the rooms are as empty as possible. Once the sale is closed, book delivery to your new house. If you require more assistance, StowNest also provides a standalone packing and moving service in Bangalore.


## **Keeping Your Things Safe**


It's understandable to be apprehensive about giving up your stuff. The warehouse has 24/7 CCTV, and regular pest control. Stored items are insured against theft for up to ₹2.5 lakhs. If an item is damaged during[transit or storage](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+) , StowNest is responsible for repair or replacement.


## **What It Costs**


The cost for storage with StowNest is dependent on the items stored as opposed to the space stored. If you are storing things from only a spare room, you aren't paying for an entire space. Contact customer support to get an estimate based on your specific situation.


## **A Few Honest Tips**


Most people think that the key to selling a property is to 'clear the extras' to showcase the space. But that's only one part of it. You must also be up front about the actual flat. The 'extras' are not the only things that need fixing. Fix things around the flat that you can easily fix. Keep your flat clean and well-lit. Let the space do the talking. Your agent can also help, as they may know what buyers in your area tend to respond to.


## **Who This Helps in Bangalore**


Owners who are selling and moving on to their next home, and tenants who are living in the flat while it is listed. This also helps households that are downsizing and have no idea what they will keep.


## **Let Buyers See the Flat, Not Your Storeroom**


Space plays a huge role in how a flat is sold. **[Temporary Storage in Bangalore](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+)** helps sellers keep all of their belongings while showing their home in the best light, and once the sale is complete, they can move onto their next chapter.

It provides a safe place to store extra furniture, boxes and other miscellaneous items while your flat is listed for sale. It helps the buyers visualize the actual space. All your items are stored securely and delivered when required.

Items that obstruct free movement and clutter the rooms and balcony are to be stored, viz., extra beds, sofas and desks, gym equipment, boxes and bulky showpieces.


**3. Is it ok to use temporary storage in Bangalore while my flat is listed for sale?**


Yes, it is designed to meet your needs for **[storage in temporary gaps](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+facility+in+bangalore+)** . The customer support will advise you based on the expected duration of sale.


**4. Can my items be delivered to my new home after the sale?**


Yes, customer support will assist in making the arrangements for delivery to the new home. StowNest also offers moving services in Bangalore as a separate service.


**5. How do storage units in Bangalore price for a small amount of furniture?**


StowNest prices storage per item, and therefore a couple of items of furniture cost less than storage for an entire house. Call customer support for a quote.


**6. Is household storage in Bangalore safe for my belongings?**
